question: Two identical cells are connected in series and then in parallel. How will the balance length on the same potentiometer wire change in the two cases? Justify your answer.

options.A: In series, the balance length remains the same; in parallel, it becomes double
options.B: In series and parallel, the balance length becomes double in both cases
options.C: In series, the balance length becomes four times; in parallel, it becomes half
options.D: In series, the balance length becomes double because the equivalent emf is $2\varepsilon$; in parallel, it remains the same because the equivalent emf is $\varepsilon$
